parity_reason: B's total is 22 and A's is 17, a gap far above 1. Several criteria also differ by up to 2 points, so parity fails even though neither image has a critical defect.

reference.summary: Santa rides a grey kick scooter through a snowy night, with one hand on the handlebar and a stack of wrapped presents in the other arm, and speed lines showing motion; it is well drawn, with small joining issues.

defects.what: The white glove sits slightly below and beside the grip, and a black knob takes the place where the hand should be, so the hand does not clearly hold the handlebar
defects.expected: Santa's gloved hand clearly wraps around the handlebar grip

defects.what: The hand under the stack of presents shows only as a white ball under the boxes, so the hold looks weak
defects.expected: Santa's arm and hand visibly cradle or hold the stack of gifts

defects.what: The hat brim covers the top of the eyes and the cheek blush overlaps the nose, which muddies the face
defects.expected: Eyes, nose and cheeks are clearly separated and readable

defects.what: Santa carries no sack of presents, only a stack of boxes
defects.expected: Santa has a sack of presents with him on the scooter

attempt.summary: Santa stands on a red kick scooter at night in the snow, with a brown sack of presents on the deck behind him; the drawing is simple and readable, but one arm is missing and the sack and gifts look pasted on.

defects.what: Only one arm is drawn; the second hand sits on the handlebar with no arm attached to it
defects.where: Santa's left side and the handlebar
defects.expected: Both of Santa's arms are drawn, each running from a shoulder to a hand gripping the handlebar

defects.what: The visible arm comes out of the beard and chest area instead of a shoulder
defects.expected: The arm is attached at the shoulder at the side of the body

defects.what: The gift boxes look flatly stuck onto the front of the sack rather than sitting in it or poking out of it
defects.where: the sack at the back of the scooter
defects.expected: The presents clearly sit inside the sack or stick out of its open top

defects.what: The sack is a stiff, slab-like shape with a flat back edge, so it reads more like a board than a soft bag
defects.where: the brown sack on the left
defects.expected: The sack has a rounded, soft bag shape with a tied or gathered top

defects.what: The big caption box at the bottom adds nothing and pulls attention from the snowy ground
defects.expected: The scene speaks for itself with no label taking up the foreground
